text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueeeen!! A commanding victory in 
the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much, everyone! For your 
cheers for me—and for the Mejiro family!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
From here on, I shall proudly forge ahead 
as a Mejiro stayer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
From here... From here, I will finally... 
walk the path... I was meant to take...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
U-Uuuuu... I am terribly sorry... For 
someone like me to... Uuuu...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"This victory is what I wanted more than 
anything this year! Please continue to 
give me your cheers and support!"

Overcome with joy, tears spilled from her 
eyes. The three-way battle of the Kikuka 
Sho concluded with Mejiro McQueen's 
victory.
(Clap clap clap...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
McQueen... *That* McQueen, crying in front 
of people...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey Ryan, today's McQueen is, how should I 
put it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The vibes were completely different, 
weren't they? From the very start, you 
could feel the electricity crackling over 
here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... The intensity was incredible, 
wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I ran with a strong heart too, but McQueen 
was just on another level today, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Hey, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think that's how it should truly 
be?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Gladly shouldering the weight of the 
Mejiro name and running to absolute 
victory. That is probably...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The true form of a Mejiro. What it truly 
means to "run a race"...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Of course, I ran with everything I had 
today too. But...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Feelings strong enough to bring tears 
naturally to my eyes... Did I have them? 
Truly... ?)
That night—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, running in the Kikuka Sho today 
made me realize something...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I knew it, maybe I'm... just a little 
different from the other Mejiro girls.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Um... like passion for the race, or the 
strength to keep aiming higher?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ryan ran in all three Classic Triple Crown 
races, and she saw every single one 
through with a sense of responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
McQueen was really emotionally invested in 
today's race, too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Still, all I was thinking was... 'Let's 
just be myself and have fun running.'"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
If you ask whether I was able to run with 
as much resolve and heart as those two, I 
don't think I quite measured up...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I love running. But—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Where is it... that I truly belong to run?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, just kidding! I just got to 
thinking for a second. Like, 'where is my 
place!?' or whatever.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, forget it, forget it! Oh yeah, wanna 
try some of that spicy pudding in the 
fridge? It's strangely addictive, you 
know~.

Dodging the question, Mejiro Palmer headed 
for the fridge. It seemed her mind wasn't 
fully made up yet.
